# Render germline clinical significance as a colored badge (Generated by Claude Sonnet 5)

Render germline clinical significance as a colored badge (Generated by
Claude Sonnet 5)

## Usage

``` r
render_classification_cell(color_palette = pcgrr::color_palette)
```

## Arguments

- color_palette:

  Named list of color palettes (default: pcgrr::color_palette), keyed
  off the "pathogenicity" set

## Value

A function that can be used as a reactable cell renderer for the
CLINICAL_SIGNIFICANCE column of the germline findings table
